chapters.title: Chapter 551: Moisturizing the silky barrier
paragraphs: The people of the Chiri Saint Clan and the Tianyun Saint Clan saw the fairy palace and couldn't help but move around.
But when they moved forward furtively, they found that they couldn't break through that repulsive force at all.
This heritage, there is already a master!
Everyone couldn't help but feel bitter and sad again.
At the same time, Su Lang smiled a little excitedly.
In the eyes of the others, this fairy palace was just a tall mansion.
But in Su Lang's eyes, it was a sacred artifact, its level almost reaching the peak of the sacred artifact.
However, perhaps because of the fall of Xianyang Martial Saint, the aura of this sacred artifact did not stand out, as if falling asleep.
"The mansion alone is of the quasi-immortal level."
"The ancient fairy sun martial sage is indeed well-deserved!"
Seeing the clearer fairy palace, Su Lang smiled slightly.
At this time.
A traction came from the map in his hand.
"This guiding force..."
Su Lang looked at the map in his hand, "Are you telling me to go to the fairy palace?"
The traction on the map was getting stronger and stronger, and it even started to tremble again.
Su Lang no longer hesitated, jumped up and flew towards the palace.
Seeing this scene, the people of Chiri Tianyun Saint Clan made their eyes green with envy and jealousy.
The people of the Yaochi Saint Clan also gathered.
Looking at Su Lang's back, some of the Yaochi Saint Clan disciples who didn't know it were totally unbelievable.
But under the explanation of Yaochi Yiran and others, they quickly understood Su Lang's power and did not feel ashamed and blushed for their ignorance.
At this moment.
Su Lang is getting closer to the fairy palace.
But at the moment when he was about to step into the fairy palace, a thin and silky barrier suddenly appeared, blocking Su Lang's front.
This barrier is really very thin, even thinner than Jiebangbang 001.
"Is this... the postgraduate entrance examination?"
"Yes, to inherit the inheritance of Xianyang Martial Saint, apart from standing out from the crowd, you also have to experience the test set by Martial Saint himself!"
"Yes, the inheritance of a generation of ancient martial sages is definitely not something that the strongest combat power can get, and other conditions must be met!"
"Hi! So, if the monster fails the test, do we have a chance?"
"It's very possible!"
The warriors of the Chiri Tianyun Saint Clan became excited.
Even Yaochi Yiran and the others had their eyes shining.
If Su Lang can get the inheritance, they will definitely not grab it, but if Su Lang can't get the inheritance, their chance will come.
at the same time.
Standing in front of the thin silky barrier, Su Lang frowned slightly.
Because the barrier in front of you is not a formation!
It was a weird method that Su Lang couldn't see through!
"It's not a formation barrier. What is this?"
Su Lang stretched out his finger with some confusion, tentatively touching the barrier.
At this moment.
Everyone held their breath, and focused on, keeping their eyes on!
Then, Su Lang's finger fell on the barrier.
The touch is very nice, bouncy and slippery.
Then, a tiny trace of peculiar energy penetrated into Su Lang's body.
Su Lang's expression was startled, and he was about to get rid of this trace of strength immediately.
But he found that Xuanyun Jingyuehuo hadn't responded.
You must know that Xuanyun Jingyuehuo possesses the purifying power, and when it encounters toxins and all kinds of strange energy harmful to the body, it will desperately rush to purify.
But at this time, it didn't move at all!
"Is this energy harmless?"
Su Lang felt it carefully and found that it was indeed harmless.
After that trace of energy entered the body, it did not spread, but moved around.
"What the are you going to do?"
Su Lang frowned slightly, ready to wipe out that trace of energy.
However, this energy wandered around in the body and then merged into the barrier through Su Lang's fingers.
"My fork, what the is this?"
Su Lang twitched the corners of his mouth with a dazed expression.
Yaochi Yiran and other soy sauce roles are also at a loss.
The scene suddenly became a bit cold.
But at this moment!
A line of big characters suddenly appeared on the barrier
——Cultivation qualification: None! !
"Fuck!"
"This turned out to be a means of testing qualifications!?"
Su Lang's face was speechless, "Speaking of my aptitude, isn't it a turbid body? You even gave me ‘nothing’ directly?"

At this time.
The map seemed to sense that he was not strong enough to get rid of Su Lang, and immediately began to increase his strength.
At the same time, the power of imprisonment from the fairy palace became more and more terrifying.
The warriors of the Chiri Tianyun Saint Clan, Yaochi Yiran and others clearly felt the depression from that powerful force.
"That map is resisting that monster!"
"Hahahaha, the opportunity I'm waiting for is coming soon!"
"Don't fight with me, I'll be the first!"
"Fuck you, why should it be you, it should be me!"
"Why don't you accept it? Come and have a fight?"
The warriors of the Chiri Saint tribe and the warriors of the Tianyun Saint tribe almost turned their faces.
The eyes of Yaochi Saint Race and others also flickered.
By this time, no one wants to get that precious opportunity!
It is conceivable that after Su Lang was imprisoned and the map broke free, it was immediately a battle!
but.

Su Lang's body trembled slightly, and the hand holding the map was like a fishing line in the middle of a hook, constantly being dragged and swayed.

When everyone saw this scene, they suddenly became nervous and excited.
Moreover, the distance between everyone was also widened to prevent someone from inserting a knife behind their backs.
It can be said that everyone is ready to compete for the map.
But what happened in the next moment immediately made them look horrified and their eyes bulged.
"Humph!"
Su Lang snorted coldly, and suddenly the breath of the Peak Martial God came from his body!
This is using the Devouring Doppelganger!
"how is this possible!"
"How can his strength reach the peak of the Martial God Realm!?"
"What kind of monster is this!"
Everyone stared at Su Lang in disbelief, as if an ordinary person had seen a ghost.
And at this moment.
Su Lang's aura climbed again, reaching the Quasi-Sage level!
A group of muscular men, yellow-haired warriors and others opened their mouths in shock, and they were dissatisfied with one foot!
The thin and silky barrier and the fairy palace seemed to be shocked, and the rising power suddenly stopped.
"The power of a mere warrior wants to imprison me? Hahahaha!"
Su Lang smiled coldly, shocked his whole body, and the terrifying force pressed back towards the fairy palace.
"boom!!"

"This monster seems to be fighting against inheritance to the end, do I really still have a chance?"
"Xianyang inheritance, you must hold on!"

chapters.title: Chapter 554: Don't be interested in me
paragraphs: The barrier shatters and annihilates like bubbles.
A resistance came from the fairy palace and fell on Su Lang.
But it was still only a one-star martial arts power, unable to stop Su Lang.
Xiangong seemed to be aware of this, and quickly dissipated the resistance, and did not do useless work.
Su Lang took another step and came to the gate of the fairy palace.
The inheritance is inside!
"Hey!"

But this is another thin barrier appeared!
What? There is still a film?
Including Su Lang, everyone was stunned.
"Oh grass, there is no end?"
Su Lang twitched the corner of his mouth and pressed his palm on the barrier.
Immediately afterwards, as before, a line of large characters emerged
——Spiritual Qualification: None! !
Looking at this line of big characters, all the Tianjiao of the Chi Ri Tianyun Yaochi tribe are all dull!
Such a terrifying monster, has no spiritual aptitude?
Is this totally impossible?
Without spiritual aptitude, how could it be possible to cultivate to such a degree?
and also!
The last two test items are physique and spirit, which means that the first test is the practice qualification test!
In other words, that monster doesn't even have the most basic cultivation qualifications! ?
Tianle, what kind of world is this?
Does it have to be without any qualifications to become a unique evildoer?
Three tribes Tianjiao's eyes twitched, messy in the wind!
"Oh, did I have no spiritual aptitude?"
Su Lang was a little stunned, and somewhat indifferent to curl his lips.
For spiritual cultivation, he has always relied on the ‘mental cultivation’ function that comes with automatic cultivation.
As for his spiritual aptitude, he only now knew it was nothing.
"It turns out that I am a three-no-person, but fortunately I have a system."
Su Lang smiled lightly, then stretched out his finger to pierce the barrier on the fairy palace gate.
Xiangong seemed to have no Fa Ke said, and did not release resistance.
The map has also accepted its fate, like an indescribable toy that has been turned off, no longer trembling with high frequency.
Even the gate of the fairy palace opened automatically.
"No! My Xianyang inheritance!"
"Ah! Is the inheritance really going to fall into the hands of that monster? I'm not reconciled!"
"Why, why don't you even give me a chance!?"
When the warriors of the three races saw this scene, the fire of hope in their hearts was completely extinguished.
However, desperate to despair, they still stared at the gate of the fairy palace, wanting to see what the inheritance of their hearts and minds was like.
And at this moment.
The gate of the fairy palace opened completely, and the inside was so dark that there was nothing to see.
Su Lang was about to walk inside, but suddenly felt the wind blowing over his face, and he couldn't help being vigilant.
At this time, a group of golden light and shadow slowly floated out, condensing into a human form in front of Su Lang.
This person's face is vague, and it can only be seen that it is a young man.
"This is? The Soul of Martial Saint!?"
"No, to be precise, it should be the soul of Quasi-Xiang! This is the soul of Xianyang Wusheng!"
Su Lang looked at the fuzzy figure in front of him, and couldn't help being a little surprised, "The soul of Xianyang Wusheng has survived to this day!?"
In the distance, the rest of the people also saw the figure that appeared in front of Su Lang, and they were shocked.
Worthy of being an ancient saint, he can actually have a means to keep his soul alive to the present!
In other words, Xianyang Wusheng is not dead! ?
"You are Xianyang Martial Saint!?"
Looking at the figure in front of him, Su Lang was slightly wary.
He could feel that although the soul of Xianyang Wusheng was very, very weak, it was still extremely terrifying!
The key is that the level of others is there!
"Yes, I am Xianyang Wusheng."
"I have lived for millions of years, and this is the first time I have seen someone as strange as you."

"There is no qualification for cultivation, no special physique, or even spiritual qualifications, but you can cultivate to the realm of Emperor Wu, and your combat power has reached the realm of Martial Saint."
Xianyang Wusheng looked at Su Lang, his face was blurred with a faint smile, "Young man, I am very interested in you!"

at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: Get up, stand up
paragraphs: "Is there any illusion or disguise?"
Su Lang gave the order faintly, "Change his appearance!!"
To be honest, it was a bit strange to see someone who looked exactly like me kneeling in front of me, although I knew it was a clone.
"Have!"
Xianyang Wusheng replied irresistibly.
As the Ancient Great Sage, this method is still available, and it is relatively advanced.
Immediately, he used a disguise technique to change his face and body shape.
This looks completely different from Su Lang.
"Well, it looks much pleasing to the eye."
Su Lang smiled faintly, threw a brick, and ordered again, "Knock your head on the brick!!"
"Boom boom boom!"
Xianyang Wusheng immediately knocked his forehead on the brick, the posture of the knocked head was very standard.
However, he looks very obedient, but his mental activity is like this:
"what!!"
"My magnificent fairy sun martial sage, never kowtow!"
"Damn! I can't control my self-control!"
"Poor me, have you become someone else's puppet? I'm not reconciled!"
"A misstep, eternal hatred——!!!"
Xianyang Martial Saint's heart is bleeding, his dignity is shattering, but he has no power to resist...
"Ok!"
"It's pretty fun!
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Okay, get up and stand obediently."
Xianyang Wusheng immediately stood up and stood obediently like the punished child.
"Do you want to die or live now?"
"If you want to live, call me Master."
"If you want to die, I will play you to death slowly. Of course, how long will you be played before you die, I don't know."
"Maybe I will keep playing until you don't want to die."
Su Lang said slowly, "Now, tell me your choice!"
In Xianyang Wusheng's heart, 100 million grassy horses ran past.
These two choices seem to be different, but in fact they are both forcing him to submit.
This is a choice!
Xianyang Wusheng's heart was running with tears, and my dignified ancient Wusheng, the existence of killing immortals in the battle of the mainland, actually fell to such a point today!
It's miserable...I feel sorry for myself!
"I choose to live..."
Xianyang Wusheng finally made his own choice.
He said bitterly in his heart: Bah, do I have a choice?
"well."
Su Lang smiled lightly, "Hand over your inheritance, everything will be given to me."
"Yes!"
"The treasures I collected before are all in the fairy palace."
Xianyang Wusheng's voice was bitter, "I actually didn't prepare for the inheritance of the exercises. I need a blank jade slip to enter the exercises."
He hadn't planned to keep the inheritance, but Poor is now forced to take out the inheritance.
"The jade slip is in the space ring."
Su Lang threw down a space ring, "Give me a clear entry of each word, otherwise your consequences will be miserable.
"Yes!"
Xianyang Wusheng nodded and caught the space ring.
He opened it and saw that the corners of his mouth twitched, only to see tens of thousands of blank jade slips inside the space ring!
"Gosh!"
Xianyang Wusheng felt bitter, "Is there tens of thousands of kungfu inheritance to be an ancient Wusheng? I am also very poor in kungfu..."
Immediately, he involuntarily took out a jade slip and began to enter the exercises inside.
"Ah!! Headache!"
As soon as it was entered, Xianyang Wusheng screamed in pain and couldn't help covering his forehead.
This is a sequelae after the seizure of the house, which damages the soul's origin. Once you do some delicate work with mental power, your head will be very painful.
"At any rate, he is also an ancient sage, called Mao?"
Su Lang waved his hand, "Forget it, now take me to get the treasure you collected."
"Yes!"
Xianyang Wusheng breathed a sigh of relief, took the jade slip, obediently turned and led the way.
He was really afraid that Su Lang would let him forcibly record the exercises. If he did that, his soul would be further traumatized.
"Hey, today is a big profit!"
Su Lang followed Xianyang Wusheng, muttering excitedly, "Not only did he harvest the possessions of Xianyang Wusheng, he also accepted an ancient Wusheng as a slave, Jie Jie Jie Jie!"
Xianyang Wusheng's face twitched, and his heart was filled with sadness and bitterness, "The person involved is here, can you keep me from hearing..."
at the same time.
Yaochi Yiran, who was a hundred miles away, and the others watched Su Lang flying towards the Immortal Palace. You can’t help but look at me, I look at you, with big eyes and small eyes...

chapters.title: Chapter 560: New features, the world of Taoism
paragraphs: Of course Yaochi Yiran and others didn't have the courage to follow.
However, they didn't want to just leave like this, so they stayed silently, looking at the high fairy palace.
Here, Su Lang has entered the fairy palace under the leadership of Xianyang Wusheng.
There is no magnificent sight in the fairy palace, it looks like the house where you live on weekdays is similar.
However, the materials used in the fairy palace are naturally extremely expensive, and holding a brick casually can make the Valkyrie eager to drool!
"Lord...Master, all my treasures are in this room."
Xianyang Wusheng pointed to a door and said with some stumbling.
It's really embarrassing for him, the superior ancient Martial Saint, to call him "Master".
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, "When I call my master in the future, be humble, respectful, and smoother, don’t you know?"
Xianyang Wusheng trembled, his face twitched involuntarily.
My God, life is so difficult, so don't be so against me, okay?
"Yes, master!"
Xianyang Martial Saint is still obedient, and his heart is forced.
"What should I do now, don't I need to teach you?"
Su Lang glanced at Xianyang Wusheng, with a hint of playfulness on his face.
"Know that..."
Xianyang Wusheng nodded in a hurry, and then opened the door.
Behind the door is a huge room, or warehouse.
It seems that the use of space technology has made the entire warehouse very large.
There are many treasures in the warehouse neatly and neatly placed in different categories. At first glance, they thought they were placed by patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder.
Su Lang walked into the warehouse, glanced around, and found a lot of rare materials, medicines, and weapons that he had never seen before.
The worst level of these treasures is also the Valkyrie level, and most of them are holy ranks!
The most important thing is the neat and tidy top-grade Lingyu and the Supreme Lingyu without digital!
"Yes, your collection is pretty good, I'm very satisfied."
Su Lang smiled slightly and waved his big hand, and the treasures and spirit jade in the warehouse began to disappear in pieces.
The warehouse, which was originally full of dangdang, was so empty that rats could run away.
"Thank you for the compliment..."
Xianyang Wusheng was so distressed that he couldn't cry without tears.
This is his millions of years of collection, all of his wealth, all at once.
Su Lang glanced at Xianyang Wusheng, no longer paying attention to him, but focused on the mysterious system space.
"System, deposit all spirit jade!"
"Ding! All spirit jade has been deposited!"
Behind the balance that has already been upgraded to ‘medium-grade jade’, the number soars!
Millions, tens of millions, millions, billions, tens of billions!
The final balance reached 11.86 billion middle-grade spirit jade!
Even if converted into high-grade spirit jade, the amount has reached a terrifying level of more than 100 million!
"Looking noisy, you deserve to be a quasi-celestial ancient great sage, there are so many spirit jade!"
Su Lang couldn't help taking a breath. Today's wave is the biggest gain in his life!
Xianyang Wusheng, what! !
"Not bad!"
Su Lang glanced at Xianyang Wusheng approvingly again.
"Hey."
Xianyang Wusheng sighed incomparably sad.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang began to upgrade the system functions: "System, first upgrade me the one-key practice function!"
"Ding! The amount of funds consumed to upgrade the system is too large. At present, the unit'medium-grade spirit jade' has been replaced with'high-grade spirit jade'."
"Ding! Consuming 1 million high-grade spirit jade, the one-key training function is increased to level 20, and the training speed is increased to 1,396736 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! It consumes 10 million high-grade spirit jade, the one-key training function is upgraded to level 21, and the training speed is increased to 2,793,472 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Congratulations on raising the one-key training function to level 20, and you have obtained the new bonus function "Daofa World"!"
The one-key training function is upgraded to level 20 in one go!
Su Lang's cultivation speed has reached 2.8 million times that of the basic cultivation speed of a genius who is close to the Wuxia level!
In other words, he has cultivated for one hour, which is equivalent to a genius of the Infinite Grade, meditating for three hundred years without auxiliary means!
And there is no need to do the whole process, any posture can be practiced automatically!
Oh grass, is there anything cooler than this in the world?

chapters.title: Chapter 561: I'm so scary
paragraphs: At this time, a lot of information poured into Su Lang's mind.
It is information about the new bonus feature "Daofa World".
Scanning the information in his mind carefully, Su Lang couldn't help but gradually become dumbfounded.

Daofa Tiandi: Open the rules of the world and automatically understand! At present, you can comprehend a specific law of heaven and earth at the same time, and the comprehension speed is 2,793,472 times that of a genius of the infinite class!
Comprehend the rules of heaven and earth, this is a cultivation method that only quasi-sages can come into contact with!
The power of the rules of heaven and earth is an important method in the Martial Saint stage.
At the martial sage level, the more rules of the world and the deeper the depth, the higher the combat power!

When Wu Sheng comprehends more rules of heaven and earth, the Wu Sheng realm is more perfect, and the inner boundary is gradually formed. When the inner boundary is reached, it is the time when Wu Sheng is promoted to Wuxian!
However, the average Wu Sheng couldn't understand a few rules in his life, and in the end he could only live and die.
It is as strong as the Xianyang Wusheng, famous in the ancient times, but failed to take that half step!
Only those who are extremely amazing and gorgeous can understand the many rules, form a perfect inner boundary, and step into the realm of Wuxian.
These people are already true evildoers!
Looking down on the Canglan Continent, Wusheng-level figures are all geniuses, but 99% of them are unable to comprehend many rules.
This shows how difficult it is to comprehend the rules of heaven and earth! !
However, Su Lang now has the function of "Daofa Tiandi" and can automatically understand the rules!
Just like automatic training, you can get terrible benefits if you lie down, sleep, stand and walk, look at the beautiful scenery and eat delicious food!
"System, you are really great!"
Su Lang was crazy about five-star praise in his heart, and then began to observe the mysterious black system space.
I saw another change in the self-cultivation villain.
At the beginning, the cultivator is white all over, and when it turns golden, he can make breakthroughs in his cultivation.
Then the spiritual cultivation was started, and a halo was added to the back of the villain's head, and the halo turned golden to make a breakthrough in the spiritual realm.
At this moment, another wisp of white mist appeared on the cultivator's body, which kept circulating around the body.
Su Lang knew that when the white entanglement turns into gold, it means that a rule has been comprehended!
Uh, this system seems to like gold a little bit, a fan...
"system."
Su Lang suddenly thought of a question and asked, "Can I designate one rule for understanding?"
"Ding! The host, you must practice the same type of exercises before you can specify and comprehend its rules!"
There seems to be a little restriction.
"I originally wanted to directly understand the rules of time or space..."
Su Lang curled his lips, then looked at the exercises he was practicing, it was messy, and he didn't know what the corresponding rules were.
However, most of them are thunder attribute exercises, in addition to fire attribute, wind attribute, and ice attribute exercises.
In addition, there are various swordsmanship and various exercise techniques.
Speaking of body-building exercises, I don’t know if there are any rules like ‘the golden spear does not fall’.
"If there is...it must be very strong after comprehension!
A weird smile appeared on Su Lang's face, and he straightened up immediately, "I'm already very powerful, and I don't need the rules in that area to strengthen myself! Look at other rules!"
After some thoughts, Su Lang's gaze aimed at the rules of the Thunder System.

"Ding! Consume 1 million high-grade spirit jade, the one-key martial arts function is increased to level 20, and the training speed is increased to 1396736 times the basic speed!"

"Ding! Congratulations on raising the one-key martial arts function to level 20. You have obtained the new bonus function ‘Five Hearts’, the ‘Founding Intention’!"
Immediately after.
A series of information appeared in Su Lang's mind.
The "Five Hearts", not surprisingly, has increased the number of exercises that can be practiced at the same time to five!
The ‘meaning of founding’ was a function that surprised Su Lang.
This function raises the proficiency ceiling of the exercises from the ‘Complete Level’ to the ‘Founding Level’!
As we all know, the exercises are all created by the martial artist.
The martial arts techniques are obscure and difficult to understand, and many places can only be understood in words.
Therefore, in the inheritance of the practice, it is inevitable that many misunderstandings will be caused, and the practice will gradually deviate from the original version.
Although it is said that there are descendants who bring forth the new and get rid of the dross.
But how can it be so easy to adapt and perfect it?
Except for the real latitude, longitude, and earth-level powers, most of the exercises handed down are getting weaker and weaker.
And the function of ‘meaning of founding’ does not mean to restore the exercise to the original version.
Rather, it supplements and perfects the original version of the original version that has been incomplete on the basis of the current practice.
The place that future generations perfected will not be abandoned or changed.
All in all, it is to replenish the good points lost in the process of spreading the exercises. There are only benefits and no harm.
"I go, and I don't know how much combat power will be added to me when all my previous exercises are upgraded to the founding level."
Su Lang was very excited, but he still planned to stop practicing the previous exercises.
Because those exercises have become more and more useless as the real combat power increases.
Even if it is promoted to the founding level, it won't take long for it to be eliminated, and the result is a waste of energy.
"Forget the previous ones."
"The exercises you will practice in the future will be promoted to the founding level!"
Su Lang licked his lips, and immediately continued to order the upgrade of the clone dispatch function!
No, there are more than 80 million high-grade spirit stones.
"Ding! Consume 10,000 high-grade spirit jade, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 17, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 17!"
"Ding! Consume...
"Ding! Consume 10 million high-grade spirit jade, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 20, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 20!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the clone dispatch function to level 20, and you have obtained the new bonus function "Clone Avatar"!"
then.

The avatar dies, the avatar can exist independently, and the avatar death will fall into a 24-hour cooling down.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: Against the sky, Gongfa synthesis!
paragraphs: Gongfa synthesis!
It turned out to be a combination of exercises!
Su Lang immediately began to check the information about ‘Gongfa Synthesis’.
Combination of Gongfa: You can use the same level of Gongfa to synthesize more advanced skills, the synthesis ratio is 10:1!

Function limitation: The exercise method used as a ‘raw material’ cannot be synthesized again, and the synthesized exercise method cannot be used as a ‘raw material’ to continue to synthesize higher-level exercises.
The introduction of the function is very simple.
But Su Lang knows that this function is super heavenly!
It is not easy to create a new exercise.
Creating high-level exercises requires extremely stringent talents, talents, experience, opportunities, and resources!
A god-level exercise technique, usually only a fairy-level boss, or even an emperor-level boss can create.
And it will take countless time and effort to perfect it!
Even so, this created method will have great flaws, and will eventually be eliminated in the long river of time.
The history of Canglan Continent does not know how many millions of years.
The exercises passed down seem to be numerous, but compared to such a long history, they are simply pitiful.
In this part of the area where Su Lang is located, the Yaochi Chiri and Tianyun stand on top of the three legs, plus the nearby small clans, the area can be used as a unit of trillion.
But in such a vast area, the holy level exercises are only one hand!
Among them, the inheritance acquired by Yanxingxing, the nine-star purple rainbow illusion canon of holy-level exercises is included.
From this we can see how rare are advanced exercises?
But now, Su Lang possesses the ability of ‘gong method synthesis’!
Only ten low-level exercises are needed to synthesize a more advanced exercise.
An incomparably rare holy-level exercise technique, only ten divine-level exercises can be synthesized!
Even if the synthesized exercises cannot be used as ‘raw materials’ to continue to be synthesized, this is extremely anti-heaven!
"What the hell."
"With this function, my god-level exercises will no longer be lacking, and I can synthesize several holy-level exercises!"

"Furthermore, when the ‘natural’ holy level exercises in my hand reach 10 copies, I will be able to get the ‘composite version’ of the immortal level exercises, which is equivalent to half a celestial inheritance!"
Su Lang was so happy that he couldn't help clapping his hands.
Immediately afterwards, he quickly took out a large number of jade slips and began to synthesize.
There are enough respect-level exercises, so I don’t bother to use the imperial-level exercises to synthesize, wasting time.
Su Lang directly synthesizes god-level skills with respect-level skills.
From the Blue Star all the way, Su Lang has hundreds of exercises.
After some synthesis, Su Lang also obtained ten god-level exercises!
You know, in the Canglan Continent, a god-level exercise is enough to support the survival and development of a small race!
Su Lang got ten copies at once!
Even if these exercises are sold, they are countless spiritual jade!
"I also have a lot of'natural' god-level exercises!"
Su Lang ticked the corner of his mouth and took out pieces of rare jade slips.
Among them, there are techniques such as the Senluo Wanxiang Jue given by Yanxingxing, as well as the Wushou Divine Body Jue obtained from the Valkyrie of the Fengling Race.
"Huh? There are only nine exercises.
Su Lang was a little surprised, and then he suddenly realized, "Although I subdued the Fengling Clan, I also destroyed the Wuyang Demon Cave.
But it's impossible for them to cultivate different methods for everyone.
The probability of the war gods of the same force practicing the same technique is very, very high! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang turned to look at Xianyang Wusheng, and smiled evilly.
"day!"
Xianyang Wu Sheng trembling, "Finally... are you finally going to do it to me?"
"Hey, why are you shaking?"
Su Lang raised his brows, "Hurry up and burn a god-level exercise for me, I want it now!"
"Oh! Yes!"
Xianyang Wusheng returned to his senses and nodded hurriedly, thinking: "Why did I forget the exercises?
This master hasn't got all of my exercises, he probably won't kill me, I'm afraid of wool.
However, what should I do when I finish burning my exercises? How about observing and seeing what the Lord likes, I will do what I like..."
Xianyang Wusheng, who was about to embark on the road of flattery, took out a blank jade slip and began to burn while thinking.
"what!!"
As soon as it was burned, the pain from the depths of the soul caused Xianyang Wusheng to whisper.
However, after all, he is the ancient great sage, with strong patience.
Xianyang Wusheng endured the pain and burned a complete god-level exercise.
"Lord...Lord, here!"
The jade slips of the exercise technique were offered with both hands, and Xianyang Wusheng was full of big men, and his complexion was ashen, obviously empty.

paragraphs: "Su Lang!"
"Brother Su Lang! Are you okay?"
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian drove their flying artifacts to Su Lang's side and looked at him with concern.
Chu Xiaobei cast a small face and flew to Su Lang's side.
"Do you think I have something to do?"
Su Lang smiled slightly and rubbed Ji Ruxue's head.
"Humph!!"
Chiri Muzhu looked ugly, and snorted coldly, "It's nothing more than coming out first. It's not yet known who will inherit the flowers!"
"Yes, I think so too!"
The martial sage of the Tianyun clan also sneered, "Maybe your Yaochi saints were driven out by our people!"
As soon as this statement came out, Yaochi Yan Fa and others suddenly looked stagnant.
At this time.
"Have you ever seen someone who was kicked out with a relaxed and happy face?"
Chu Xiaobei smiled coldly and stood forward, "Have you seen the defeated party without any casualties?"
"Humph!"
"Maybe it is the joy of the rest of your life!"
Chirimuzhu's face sank and said, "When our people come out, you should accept reality!"
"Yes, I think so too!"
"Our two clans have already reached an alliance agreement, and it is impossible to lose to your Yaochi clan!"
One day, Wu Sheng of the Yun Sheng clan continued, "Who wins and who loses has already been determined. Your people are just lucky and escaped."
"Hahahaha!"
"Crimson Sun Pearl, don't waste your time waiting for the red, yellow and green tribes."
"The people of your two races have all been killed by this son."
Su Lang laughed loudly, and a touch of irony was outlined at the corner of his mouth, "Inheritance, naturally fell into my hands!
"This is impossible!"
Chiri Muzhu's pupils shrank suddenly, "Our two clans join hands, how can you be opponents?"
"Ha ha!"
"If you don't believe it, just wait here."
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, "Otherwise you can send some more people in to look for them, maybe you can find some dead bodies."
"This..."
Chiri Muzhu and the other Martial Saints looked at each other, their faces sinking like water, extremely ugly!
Su Lang dared to say that, the Tianjiao of the Chiri and Tianyun races might have been wiped out.
At this time.
Chu Xiaobei turned her head and asked Su Lang, "Have you got it?"
"Of course I got it!"
"And more than that."
Su Lang laughed, "Don't you find that we have one more person than when we entered?"
"Of course I found it."
Chu Xiaobei nodded and looked at Xianyang Wusheng, "Who is he?"
Yaochi Yan Fa and others also pointed their ears.
They are all in the realm of Martial Saint, and they found extra people early in the morning, but they didn't have time to ask for a while.
"He."
"First of all, he is my minion."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Secondly, he is the Great Sage of the Ancient Immortal Sun!"
As soon as he said this, the whole process was silent for an instant, and the roots and curls could be heard clearly.
What the hell?
Xianyang Wusheng is still alive! ?
How is this possible? Didn't he fall in the battle of the continents at the node of the era! ?
Yaochi Yan Fa, Chiri Muzhu and others were all dumbfounded!
"You...you said he is the Great Sage of Xianyang and your slave!?"
Chu Xiaobei glared at Su Lang in disbelief, "I can believe you that he is Xianyang Martial Saint, but you say that he is your slave, I really don't believe it!"
The great saint who was famous in the ancient capital suddenly became a slave to the younger generation!
How do you hear this?
"This is impossible!"
Chiri Muzhu stepped forward excitedly, "Even if Xianyang Martial Saint lives to the present, he will never be your slave!"
"Yes, I think so too!"
"Xianyang Wusheng is invincible under the immortal level, how can he be your slave!"
Tianyun Saint Clan Yi Wusheng coldly pointed at Xianyang Wushengdao, "This person must be fake!"
"Correct!"
"This person is definitely not Xianyang Wusheng!"
"An ancient martial sage was a slave, I didn't dare to do it in my dream!"
The martial sages in the red, yellow and green camp shouted.
"Humph!!"
"How can you be qualified to question my master!"
Xianyang Wusheng suddenly snorted, a unique temperament exuded.
He has been in a high position for millions of years, killing countless, and his unique strong temperament has been carved into his bones.
At this time, it was deliberately revealed, and it instantly suppressed Chiri Muzhu and other "juniors".

Because he suddenly discovered that he had mastered the four venerable techniques in an instant!
And the proficiency is very very high!
"Before breaking through the realm was without warning, now I have learned the four exercises without warning.
Needless to say, it must be the master's reason!"
Xianyang Wusheng quickly thought of the key, and his gaze at Su Lang couldn't help becoming more in awe and admiration.
His resentment towards Su Lang was no longer left, and there was nothing but gratitude in his heart!
On the other side,
Su Lang came to the link of selecting exercises again.
This time, he intends to practice all the god-level techniques!
The current practice rate of the one-key martial arts function is abnormally against the sky.
It takes 10,000 to 20,000 years for an ordinary Valkyrie to practice the god-level exercises at the Consummation level, and it only takes two days to complete the practice!
"Now I can practice five exercises at the same time!"
"First improve your body skills, then make up for your defense and endurance, and resolutely avoid making short legs and crispy skin."

They are "Bai Ze Fei Hua Jue Lu", "Zhen Shui Wan Zhang Zhen Jue", "Bagua Immortal Treasures", "Dian Li Taiqing God Axis", "Nine Turns and Nine Palaces".
There are two self-style exercises, two defensive exercises, and the last one is exercises for increasing endurance.
"System, put these five exercises!"
"Ding!
The placement is successful, and the automatic training has begun!"
As the system prompt appeared, in the mysterious black space, all five Wushu villains moved.
Two of them are constantly dancing and moving, their body skills are flexible and difficult to capture; a thin barrier emerges from the body of the two, which looks very strange.
The last one circulates nine energy streams inside and outside the body, which gives a sense of majestic energy at first glance.
"God-level exercises."
Su Lang looked forward to it, "A god-level technique reaches the founding level.
I'm afraid it can directly improve the martial to a small level!"
Placed the exercises.
Su Lang separated from Yaochi Yan Fa and others temporarily and left the teleportation array.
Although Yaochi Yan Fa and others had all kinds of doubts in their hearts, they could only hold back in their hearts and let Su Lang leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Master and three mistresses
paragraphs: Not long.
Su Lang returned to the sacred land of the Yaochi tribe, the heart of the mountains with the three sisters and Xianyang Wusheng.
In one room, the four of Su Lang sat down, their eyes all on Xianyang Wusheng.
Xianyang Wusheng stood there obediently, looking like a servant.
Chu Xiaobei asked curiously: "Su Lang, how did you accept him as a subordinate?"
As soon as these words came out, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian both showed curiosity in their eyes.
"This matter is also very strange."
Su Lang smiled lightly, and then recounted what had happened in the inheritance space.
The three girls were amazed when they heard this.
Unexpectedly, it was such a coincidence.
"Then what is the name of Xianyang Wusheng?" Ji Ruxue asked curiously.
Su Lang looked at him, he really didn't know.
So, he opened the attribute panel of Xianyang Wusheng.
[Name]: Clone (Li Xianyang)
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Zhunwuzun
[Attack level]: Peak Warrior
[Defense level]: Intermediate Valkyrie
[Shenfa Level]: Intermediate Valkyrie+
[Endurance level]: Intermediate Valkyrie
[Spirit level]: the realm of morning star (the realm of bright moon)
[Mastering the exercises]: The Infinite Heart Sutra, the Ten Ultimate Lingxiao Profound Sword...
"Xianyang Wusheng, named Li Xianyang."
Looking at the attribute panel, Su Lang answered Ji Ruxue with a smile.
At the same time, he also understood that Li Xianyang didn't take the title "Xianyang Wusheng" for pretending to be force, but that his real name was.
This was misunderstood by the world, and thought that he was arrogant, and put the character "Xian" specifically for himself.
"It was called Li Xianyang."
Ji Ruxue nodded suddenly.
Li Xianyang was a little surprised!
His real name is not very useful in ancient times, it has always been used.
And Su Lang had never asked his name, but he knew it clearly. This method was really unheard of.
"It's the master..."
Li Xianyang's respect and loyalty to Su Lang could not help but increased a lot.
"Li Xianyang?"
Chu Xiaobei looked at Li Xianyang curiously and asked, "Tell me, what is the battle of the mainland like?"
"Speak carefully, I want to hear it too."
Su Lang nodded solemnly.
"Yes!"
Li Xianyang nodded and said, "The master and the three mistresses should know..."
"Ahem!"
"What three mistresses!?"
Chu Xiaobei trembled and interrupted Li Xianyang with staring eyes.
However, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian's complexion was crimson, slightly shy, and did not refute.
"what!?"
"Aren't they three mistresses!?"
Li Xianyang was stunned. He always thought that the three girls around Su Lang were all his mistresses.
"Haha, of course not!"
Su Lang laughed suddenly, "Xiao Bei is my maid!"
"Su Lang's big look. Demon!"
"I want to squeeze your neck today!"
Chu Xiaobei's eyes widened violently, and he rushed towards Su Lang with teeth and claws.
The appearance of gnashing his teeth really demonstrated the true meaning of Yan Yi.
Immediately afterwards, Chu Xiaobei grabbed Su Lang's neck and shook it fiercely: "I will let you say that I am your maid, and I will let you say that I am your maid..."
"Sister Xiaobei, don't be angry!"
"Sister Xiaobei, don't pinch Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian hugged Chu Xiaobei's arm and were thrown around.
"What's wrong with Chu Xiaobei?"
"You don't want to be the maid of my Patriarch, and you dare to act on my Patriarch?"
"Tian Le, could it be that women in this era are more willful than my era!?"
Seeing this scene, Li Xianyang blinked in wonder.
Of course, he also knew that Chu Xiaobei didn't really fight with his owner, so he didn't interfere either.
"Oh, do you still need to refine someone's flying treasure?"
Su Lang, who was shaken by Chu Xiaobei's neck, rolled his eyes and threatened.
"I'm almost done designing, you dare to put the burden on me!?"
Chu Xiaobei's eyes were full of fierce light, and he directly overthrew Su Lang to the ground, riding on him and shaking his neck harder.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: Canglan Continent is downwind
paragraphs: Shake and shake, shake and shake~
Ups and downs in body shape...
"Ouch!"
"Chu Xiaobei, don't shake it, it's almost a rattle, I really can't stand me!"
Su Lang yelled, but he secretly smiled in his heart: "Chu Xiaobei really looks like an automatic Ji now!"
What do you mean by Zhuo Ji?
Have you ever heard of a saying, "Sit up and move by yourself"?
"Dead pervert, you say, will you train for me!?"
Chu Xiaobei stopped shaking, but still riding on Su Lang with a fierce look on his face.
She was so good-looking, she couldn't be fierce no matter what.
"I surrender!"
Su Lang smiled and nodded, "I will do it for you!"
"Humph!"
Chu Xiaobei rolled her face proudly, and she trembled, causing an uproar.
"nice shot!"
Su Lang secretly praised in his heart and wanted to applaud Chu Xiaobei.
Immediately afterwards, Chu Xiaobei got up from Su Lang.
The feeling of warmth gradually disappeared, and Su Lang was a little lost.
"Brother Su Lang, are you all right."
Suddenly Ji Ruxue's voice rang.
Looking along the sound, she and Murong Xian's faint gaze can still be seen.
These two girls are jealous!
"Haha!"
"Chu Xiaobei is just, what can she do to me?"
Su Lang laughed and said, "I promise not to be ridden by her in the future."
"Humph!"
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian hummed in unison, and then they ran to Chu Xiaobei's side.
When Su Lang saw that they seemed to be whispering, he could vaguely hear words like ‘Sure enough’ and ‘Big Devil’.
"What a serious person I am..."
Su Lang curled his lips, got up from the ground and beckoned to Li Xianyang.
"Master!"
Li Xianyang bowed respectfully and waited for instructions.
Su Lang smiled, "Continue to talk about the mainland war."
"The fundamental reason for the battle of the ancient continent was the war of annexation of the rules of the Great Dao."
"This is a great battle that all creatures can't avoid on the entire continent!"

Li Xianyang's eyes were deep, with a hint of memory, "During the war, the emperor was the top combat power, the immortal level was the secondary combat power, and the saint-level warriors were inconspicuous, and the warriors of the lower realm were even called cannon fodder!"
Su Lang nodded and asked, "Who was he fighting with in the last war? What was the situation?"
"It's the Mirror Heaven Continent, our old rival in Canglan Continent."
"The situation was very bad at that time. The warriors of Jingtian Continent have crossed the distant void and hit the mainland of Canglan Continent."
"At the beginning, I died together with a fairy-level warrior. I used mystery technique to survive, and I didn't know much about what happened later.
Li Xianyang replied, "But now, the Canglan Continent is doing a good job, presumably it must have repelled the gang of turtle grandchildren in Jingtian Continent."
"That's it."
"Our Canglan Continent is downwind."
Su Lang nodded and asked immediately, "When do you think the next mainland battle will start? What is the winning rate of our Canglan Continent?"
"As far as I know, in recent times, the gap between two continental wars has become shorter and shorter. The next continental war may not be far away."
"As for the winning rate... if there are no amazing talents in these years, our Canglan Continent may not have a big winning rate."
Li Xianyang was worried while talking.
The Canglan Continent is full of tens of thousands of people, and the internal fighting is very fierce.
This is almost the instinct of all creatures in the Canglan Continent.
"Haha."
"If you mean tens of thousands of years when you mean'not far away,' that is too long for me."
Su Lang smiled faintly and changed the subject, "It happens to be okay now, you come with me, and I will refine some pills for you to eat."
After speaking, he turned and walked to an empty room.
"The Lord will refine the pill!?"
"And is it refined for me to eat?"
"In other words, what the Lord is refining is a holy pill!"
"As expected to be my lord, it's amazing."
Li Xianyang admired, and then followed Su Lang closely.
Chu Xiaobei, Ji Ruxue, and Murong Xianxian glanced at Su Lang and went on to chat.
Just now I talked about refining flying treasures.
Chu Xiaobei planned to brainstorm to see if Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian had any good ideas.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: Why are you so excited!
paragraphs: The other side.
Yaochi Yan Fa and other five great martial arts gathered together.
Below, Yaochi Yiran and other young talents who entered the inheritance space are leaving.
Through the description of Yaochi Yiran and others, Yaochi Yanfa and others' perception of Su Lang changed again.
"According to what Yiran and the others said, Young Master Su Lang is likely to be a clone of a great figure!"
"Yes, I don't have any qualifications for cultivation, but I have extremely powerful combat power, and the strength of Martial Saint can burst out at the critical moment!"

"Various characteristics show that Young Master Su Lang may really be a clone of a great figure, but Young Master Su Lang is also suspected of being a direct descendant of the imperial family. This is undeniable."
"In any case, the identity of Young Master Su Lang is honorable, and I must not neglect it, and don't visit others."
"Understood, Patriarch, there may be future troubles in the Wuyang Demon Cave. You are not here today. Our people have found a strange person on the old site of the Wuyang Demon Cave."

"The backstage of Wuyang Devil's Cave is suspected to be Slaughter Tower. This organization is spread all over the Canglan Continent. Its strength is very terrifying. It has always acted unscrupulously. If Slaughter Tower really takes action against us, how can we resist it?"
"President Su Lang is here, so I don't have to worry too much. I will pass on the order, strengthen inspections, and report it as soon as there is a disturbance."
"Well, besides, it's time to bring up the refining of the Sky Sea. When the time is right, I will ask Young Master Su Lang to ask her Maid Chu Xiaobei to take action."
"Crimson Sun Saint Clan and Tianyun Saint Clan also pay attention to that, and the Biyu Saint Clan."
When Yaochi Yan Fa and others have finished their discussions.
Su Lang also refined the pill for curing Li Xianyang's soul injury.
The elixir used was obtained from Yaochi Yan Fa, and Chu Xiaobei had also used it before healed his injuries.
As for the material.
After killing the two martial sages of Wuyang Devil's Cave, and also getting Li Xianyang's wealth, Su Lang is now a big man and he has no shortage.
So he refined a lot, and finally synthesized it into a quasi elixir!
Quasi-immortal pill, the strongest pill of holy order!
The one given by Su Lang is still a quasi elixir of perfect quality.
When Li Xianyang took the medicine, his hands were shaking.
Growing up, he has never eaten a perfect quality quasi elixir.
It sounds like a poor kid who hasn't eaten lollipops in his teens.
And Li Xianyang’s excited and grateful look was like saying: "I, Li Xianyang, have also eaten lollipops, hahahaha!"
"Go, heal the injury earlier, ask me if the medicine is not enough, I can practice the elixir."
Su Lang waved his hand faintly, looking calm, looking at money like dirt.
"Tianle!"
"As expected of my master, the elixir can be refined!"
Li Xianyang's eyes gleamed and he was very excited, "I am afraid that my master is not the super sky rising in this era, the protagonist of the era!!"
Soon.
With deep excitement, Li Xianyang thanked him for his great grace, and went to heal his wounds with the quasi-immortal pill.
"By the way, after the one-click treasure hunt upgrade, the treasure hunt flying flying swan hasn't been released yet."
"It was said before that we would send treasure hunting flying flying gliders to the land of the Chiri Saint Clan and the Tianyun Saint Clan to catch the autumn breeze."
Su Lang raised his eyebrows suddenly, and immediately released 2.8 million treasure hunting flying flying gliders.
Immediately afterwards, the dense treasure hunting flying flying gliders rushed towards the territory of the Chiri and Tianyun tribes while hunting for treasures.
At the same time, the system prompt sound also sounded, ding ding ding sound continuously.
Su Lang quickly blocked these system prompts.
Immediately after.
He came to the outside of the room with his hands behind his back and a slight smile.
The three of Chu Xiaobei still gathered together, talking.
As soon as Su Lang came out, the three women immediately turned their heads and stared at him, and they all stood up.
"Oh grass, what is this for?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and his heart secretly said something bad, "It's not because of the previous things, you want to get together to clean up me?"
"Ahem!"
"Sit down, all sit down!"
Su Lang gave a light cough, waved his hands and smiled, "We have something to say."
Ji Ruxue said with a strange look: "No, Brother Su Lang, we didn't plan to do anything to you."
"what?"
Su Lang's expression was stagnant, and then he smiled, "Then what are you guys?"
"Hehe!"
Chu Xiaobei smiled, "That's it, I have already figured out what my flying treasure will be."
"Oh!"
"It turned out to be this!"
"Why are you so excited? Isn't it a flying treasure? I can refine it easily."
Su Lang laughed, "Come here, talk about what kind of flying treasure you want."

puff!

Su Lang looked at Chu Xiaobei with a dazed expression, and asked secretly whether she had awakened some indescribable characteristics.
"Brother Su Lang, what are you doing in a daze?"
Seeing Su Lang there, Ji Ruxue was a little dumbfounded, and couldn't help asking strangely, "Isn't the big bird bad?"
"Yeah, isn't Big Bird okay?"
Murong Xianxian also asked confusedly.
"Roar, roar, roar, big bird!"
Su Lang nodded hurriedly, "If Big Bird, all three of you can ride!"
"Correct!"
Ji Ruxue smiled, "From now on we will ride with Sister Xiaobei!"
"Hmm."
"When I am here in the future, you don't need to take out your marshmallows and wings!"
Chu Xiaobei said happily, "From now on, I will take you to fly!"
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian nodded quickly, their eyes turned into crescent moons.
At this time.
Su Lang rolled his eyes and asked, "Well, what kind of big bird do you want? Has it been designed? If not, I can..."
"You can not!"
Chu Xiaobei crouched on her hips and interrupted Su Lang's words fiercely in the uproar.
"Good good!"
"Can't afford to offend!"
Su Lang immediately admitted that he felt that he could not bully Chu Xiaobei at will as before.
Not only because Chu Xiaobei's cultivation base was restored.
Also because she played with Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian.
Once Chu Xiaobei was bullied, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian would jump out to clean him up.
This woman is so cunning!
"Alright, Su Lang, listen carefully, the big bird I want is similar to the phoenix in Ruxue's mouth!"
There was a look of longing in Chu Xiaobei's eyes, "You and Ruxue and Xianxian come from the same place. You should know what a phoenix is!"
"Phoenix? Of course I know this!"
Su Lang's mouth twitched and nodded.
In fact, he was a little strange, it was strange that there was no phoenix in Canglan Continent.

Moreover, since stepping into the Canglan Continent, I have never seen a dragon-shaped spirit beast, at most I have seen the bones of a dragon and snake, that is, the one in Li Xianyang's inheritance space.
However, thinking of the identity of Blue Star's ‘core fragment of the Boundless Realm’, perhaps an explanation can be found.
The real dragon, as well as the phoenix, may be the high and transcendent creatures that only the Infinity Realm has.
The corners of the Canglan Continent exist in a remote place, and there is no such thing as a Phoenix.
"The Phoenix I want, it must be white and pure!"
Chu Xiaobei said with bright eyes, "It needs to have a beautiful figure, big beautiful eyes, a sweet cry, and a long tail."
Oh grass, such a weak description...
Also, the four words white and pure are always reminiscent of a certain name.
"Ahem, would you like to draw it?"
Su Lang twitched his mouth and made a pertinent suggestion.
"It's so stupid, don't you have any imagination?"
Chu Xiaobei frowned and showed the phoenix in his mind.
However, the phoenix in her impression was formed by her own imagination and the descriptions of Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian.
Therefore, it was somewhat different from the Phoenix in Su Lang's memory.
The biggest difference is that the phoenix that Chu Xiaobei wants has countless tails, or Lingyu.
This made Su Lang think of the thousands of threads in the sea of knowledge.
In addition, the phoenix portrayed by Chu Xiaobei is really very white, except that the eye beads are black, and even the paws are white.
At first glance, I thought it was albinism.
However, Phoenix's temperament is very cold, which is more similar to Chu Xiaobei.
Of course, it was only when Chu Xiaobei was quiet.
"How about? Does this phoenix look good?"
Chu Xiaobei tilted her head and looked at Su Lang proudly.
"Good-looking, good-looking!"
Su Lang nodded hurriedly, and then said, "I think your Phoenix's paws can be made into the color of translucent ice jade, how about?"

chapters.title: Chapter 576: This smelly sister is cheaper
paragraphs: "Oh, well, I actually think so with Ruxue and Xianxian."
Chu Xiaobei blinked, "I drew like this, just to see how your aesthetic is."
As soon as he said this, Ruxue and Xianxian couldn't help but giggled while covering her mouth.
Obviously, Chu Xiaobei was stubborn and wanted white claws, but he felt that Ruxue and Xianxian made sense. In the end, he hesitated and planned to see Su Lang's reaction.
"It seems that my aesthetics are pretty good."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, "I already know how to refine the big bird you want. By the way, give me your Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky Aya, and I will repair it together."
"Okay!"
Chu Xiaobei had long wanted to repair his magic sky, and quickly gave it to Su Lang with a smile.
"Then you go and rest."
Su Lang nodded, "I will refine your white phoenix from here and come to you."
Immediately, Su Lang bid farewell to the three daughters of Chu Xiaobei and returned to an empty room again.
Because when the system refines weapons and treasures out of thin air, the style is random.
So refining the white phoenix flying treasure requires Su Lang himself.
It's Bingyun Huantian Ling, just let the system evolve.
So, after spending the last two copies of the Soul of the Valkyrie and some rare materials, Su Lang evolved the Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky into a seven-star holy artifact.
Even though Bing Yun Huan Tian Ling has only evolved by one star, it has changed from an intermediate sacred artifact to an advanced sacred artifact.
However, Bing Yun Huan Tian Ling's appearance has also changed, a little colorful, and I hope Chu Xiaobei will not dislike it.
After the Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky Aya evolved, Su Lang began to refine the White Phoenix Flying Treasure.
Chu Xiaobei herself is a six-star martial sage, and her combat power reaches a nine-star martial sage. Her flying treasure must at least be a sacred weapon.
But Su Lang discovered that he no longer had the soul of the Valkyrie.
"It seems that you can only use the soul of Wusheng."
"It's really cheap for this stinky sister, and I must get some benefits from her in the future."
Posing his lips, Su Lang first decomposed the holy order pill furnace water and moon gold furnace, and then refined it into a holy order cauldron.
"How do I feel that I am still poor?"
"Even a cauldron has to disassemble the original pill furnace to make it."
"Hey, I have to find a few opportunities to kill some martial sages, but who will give me the head?"
While thinking about it, Su Lang began to refine the white phoenix.
This is not the first time he has refined treasures by himself.
When he was in the stronghold, Shiqi and Qiudong Wuzun insisted to teach him how to refining tools, but his eyes were almost lost in shock.
"Lagerstroemia has no fixed fire!"
With a thought, a large group of flames appeared around the saint step vessel and turned into a mist to wrap it up.
At this time, Su Lang discovered some problems.
The crape myrtle fire that he urged was not high enough, and the furnace was not big enough.
Some headaches covered his forehead, Su Lang used the Devouring clone to push his strength to a one-star martial sage.
At this level, the power of Ziwei Wudinghuo is barely enough.
Su Lang made up his mind to comprehend the fire element in the next rule after the thunder element rules were comprehended!
Otherwise, in the future, if you only have alchemy through refining, the fire is ready, and the result is not enough to melt the materials, it would be too embarrassing.
After solving the minor problems, Su Lang officially began to refine the White Phoenix.
"The first piece of material, Nandou Copper! Processing is complete!"
"The second piece of material, too much ice rock! Processing is over!"
"The third material..."
Pieces of materials are turned into materials to be used by Su Lang's hands.
His technique is very superb. If there is a master craftsman here, whether it is a sage, a fairy or an emperor, he will definitely kneel down and doubt life.
"It's a pity that no one is watching."
Su Lang curled his mouth and continued to process the materials.
Some materials that can be processed by the system are handed over to the system.

In a short time, Su Lang processed all the materials, a total of nine hundred and ninety-nine god-level materials, ninety-nine holy-level materials, and one piece of the soul of the martial sage is another.
After processing the materials, Su Lang did not intend to do it all by himself.
Because he already knows what materials can be refined into what kind of things.
Therefore, he handed over these tasks to the system.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: Break through the realm of Wu Zun
paragraphs: "System, refining these materials into a treasure!"
"These materials are also refined into a treasure!"
Soon, pieces of treasure appeared in front of Su Lang, like a pile of parts.
Yes, Su Lang's idea is to refine parts and then combine them.
The combination is the last step, this step requires Su Lang to do it himself.
But the bulk of the work has been almost done by the system, and Su Lang only took a short half a day to complete the last step.
At this time, a system prompt sounded.
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"
"breakthrough."
Su Lang's expression moved, and he gave the order.
This time a breakthrough is from a quasi-zun to a junior martial-zun, and it will take a big step!
Therefore, the movement is still a bit big.
Chu Xiaobei, Ruxue and Xianxian all felt the spiritual energy around them rushing towards the room where Su Lang was.
"Brother Su Lang is about to break through!"
"Wow, Brother Su Lang is amazing!"
Ruxue and Murong Xian have stars in their eyes.
"Su Lang big pervert broke through!"
"Furthermore, this breakthrough is actually going to reach the level of Wu Zun!"
"This... didn't this guy just broke through a few days ago? Why did he break through suddenly?"
Chu Xiaobei stared at the room where Su Lang was, and her delicate body trembled slightly, causing a wave of fluctuations.
At the same time, Li Xianyang, who was healing, suddenly opened his eyes.
"The Lord broke through!
"I... I also broke through!"
"Hahahaha!"
"The Lord is definitely the fastest cultivator in the world!"
"It is really the greatest blessing that Li Xianyang has ever been able to meet and follow the Lord!"
Li Xianyang opened his arms with shock and surprise on his face.
The other side.
"The realm of elementary Wuzun!"
Su Lang was looking inside his body.
The breakthrough from the realm of Wuhuang to the realm of Wuzun does not involve the transition of the essence of life.
However, a breakthrough in such a great realm still brings many changes.
Not to mention the toughness and strength of the body's flesh and blood meridians and bones, the biggest change is the Dantian.
At this time, the aura nucleus in Su Lang's Dantian had grown to almost fill the entire Dantian space.
This scene made Su Lang couldn't help but complain: "Your sister, it looks like she is pregnant with a stone."
Closer to home.
The huge aura nucleus fills the dantian, and it itself is different from the previous form.
The spiritual energy crystal core at this time gave Su Lang a semi-illusory feeling, as if it could be dispersed at any time.
But Su Lang couldn't do this.
It feels like a film that can be broken at any time, but it just doesn't break.
It is very worrying.
After trying, Su Lang simply gave up.
Immediately, he checked some classics and found that this type of aura nucleus was related to the Valkyrie domain.

As long as the aura nucleus grows to the extreme, that is, the quasi-sage realm, and then blends into a space guide, it can "break the membrane" and achieve the aura nucleus gathering and dispersing from the heart.
And the form of aura nucleus dispersing, actually manifested is the domain!
Of course, Su Lang would not use the space guide, because that would cause many side effects.
And he doesn't need space guidance at all, he has an automatic cultivation function, and he just breaks through when the time comes.
After looking inside, Su Lang opened his attribute panel and took a look.
"Properties panel!"
[Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Junior Wuzun
[Attack level]: Peak Warrior
[Defensive Level]: Intermediate Valkyrie+
[Shenfa level]: Senior Valkyrie
[Endurance Level]: Intermediate Valkyrie+
[Spirit Level]: Realm of Morning Star
[Mastering the exercises]: The Infinite Heart Sutra, the Ten Ultimate Lingxiao Profound Sword...
(Part of the information has been omitted [click here] to view.)
"There is no movement in the attack realm, and the remaining three attributes each increase by half a small realm, which is a good profit."
Su Lang smiled with satisfaction, slowly decomposing the saint step vessel cauldron, and then refining it into a water moon gold furnace.
Immediately, he left the room with the freshly baked white phoenix, and walked briskly towards the room where Chu Xiaobei lived.
The heart of the mountains was not big, and Su Lang was so fast that he walked to the door of Chu Xiaobei's room in a few steps.
He raised his hand and knocked on the door.

Puff, does this have anything to do with what I refine?

At this time.

This big bird is fast enough!

chapters.title: Chapter 583: I'm afraid it's not the mistress who turned back
paragraphs: For ordinary people, even if they master the layout of the teleportation array, it is very troublesome to arrange the teleportation array.
Because the teleportation arrays are at least two in a set, and they are far apart from each other.
If it is arranged by one person, it is arranged here, and it is really troublesome to run a long way to arrange another one.
If the distance is particularly far, it is almost impossible for one person to arrange the teleportation array.
This is also because the number of ultra-long teleportation arrays on the Canglan Continent is very, very rare.
However, arranging the teleportation array was too simple for Su Lang.
long distance?
Duplicate dispatch plus duplicate replacement is over!
After half an hour, Su Lang set up the two teleportation arrays.
The other side is located at the entrance of Canglan Continent in the time-space crack.
"The teleportation array is finished, let's go."
Su Lang waved his hand, and the three women who were chatting immediately surrounded him.
Immediately, a burst of light flashed, and the four figures of Su Lang disappeared.
The area of the Fengling tribe, where the time and space cracks are located.
Because the headquarters of the exchange system is set up here, a relatively simple gathering place has been formed here.
Around the space-time crack guarding the great formation, there are shelters and caves built by warriors everywhere.
Everyone is eagerly waiting for the exchange opportunity once a day.
Those warriors below the Martial King level are practicing recklessly, looking forward to one day they can reach the Martial King level and obtain the qualification to use the exchange system.
At this moment.
Inside the space-time crack guarding the large array, a teleportation array lit up.
"coming!"
Yan Hengxing, Huangfuqin, and the four human war gods stood aside very excitedly, waiting for Su Lang's return.
When Su Lang arranged the teleportation array, he naturally alarmed Yan Xingxing.
So Yanxingxing notified Huangfuqin and the four human war gods, and everyone gathered here.
Immediately afterwards, the light dissipated, and the four figures of Su Lang appeared in the eyes of everyone.
"Welcome to the patriarch!"
When Yan Hengxing, Huangfuqin and other six people saw Su Lang, they saluted immediately.
During this period of time, although Su Lang was not in the clan, he kept bringing good things to them, and there was no shortage of any weapon and pill, which piled up their loyalty to the extreme.
"Well, don't be so polite."
Su Lang waved his hand faintly, "When I am away, thanks to you for protecting the tranquility and peace of the two races."
"This is what I should do!"
Huangfuqin said excitedly, Yan Xingxing and others also nodded again and again.
"Haha."
"I will introduce you to you."
Su Lang pulled Chu Xiaobei over and said with a smile, "This is a genius of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, a six-star martial sage, Chu Xiaobei.
"Hello."
Chu Xiaobei smiled slightly, and at the same time he thought to himself: I didn't expect that Su Lang, the big pervert, is really the lord of the clan, no, it seems to be the lord of the two clans!
"I have seen Senior Chu!"
Huangfuqin and others were shocked and immediately saluted respectfully.
Tianle!
The genius of the fairy clan, and a six-star martial sage, this is a real big shot!
However, these characters actually went home with their owner, and they seem to be very kind, what's the relationship? Afraid it wasn't the mistress who came back?
Huangfuqin and others secretly exchanged their eyes, and they all felt the excitement of the other party.
"You should all know these two, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian."
Su Lang ignored the reactions of Huangfuqin and others, and continued to introduce Ruxue and Xianxian.
Of course, Huangfuqin and others knew about Ruxue and Xianxian.
Because Su Lang once asked them to send someone to search for them.
The relationship between these two women and Su Lang is extraordinary.
Therefore, Huangfuqin and others once again saluted together: "I have seen a snow girl, a slender girl!"
Ruxue and Xianxian followed Su Lang and were respectfully saluted by Wu Sheng. So they didn't panic and responded generously.
"From now on, Ruxue and Xianxian will participate in the management of the two clans."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "You have to help them."

chapters.title: Chapter 585: Evolution Youtian Sword
paragraphs: When he came back this time, Su Lang didn't intend to make a big noise.
The main purpose is to accompany Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian to see their homeland and recall the happy time before.
Therefore, he did not go to Xuanyuan Wudao Academy to pretend to be forced, but took the three daughters to Nanlin City, Dongfang City, and Red Maple Town.
At the end of the war, the Fengling clan gave up the control of the beast, and still thrived.
These fierce beasts have become wild species, and they have gradually been domesticated and become spiritual pets.
However, the ones that have not been domesticated are still very cruel and need to be hunted.
But the beast wave will never appear again, which makes every city feel relieved and begin to grow and develop.
A peaceful life makes people have stronger spiritual needs, so many weird things have been made out.
Chu Xiaobei has never been in contact with Blue Star's culture, so he will be curious about many things.
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian followed her and ran around, while Su Lang stood aside, smiling softly.
However, Su Lang seemed to be doing nothing on the surface, but in fact he was paying attention to Youtian Sword.
From the treasure house of the saints of Yaochi, Su Lang obtained a total of twenty-nine souls of the of war and two souls of the of war.
This has already filled up the missing materials at the end of the Youtian Sword upgrade.
"system!"
Su Lang ordered, "Only retain the current characteristics, evolve the Youtian Sword!"

"Ding! Consumes the holy refining material Yuanshiyan*6, Mingxin jade*6, Bodhi Treasure Heart*6, 蓞Amethyst*6... Extreme Heart Saint Lucky*6 God-level refining material Valkyrie Soul*10...The Youtian Sword has evolved into an Intermediate Saint Soldier!"
Inside the storage space.
The Youtian Sword's brilliance flashed, and the aura became more intense in an instant, and the three rules of "breaking defense", "lossless" and "slashing soul" became more powerful!
"This is the pinnacle of the Six-Star Sacred Artifact!"
"Tsk tusk, if the Youtian Sword was at this level when attacking Wuyang Devil's Cave, then Wuyang Martial Sage would die with a single sword!"

at this time.

Next.

At this time.

At this time, the refining of the sea of sky has indeed completed the refining, but why does Su Lang say that the refining has not been completely completed?

Why is the design of the sea of sky divided into twelve subjects and twelve bridges, and the twelve bridges are each subdivided into twelve parts?

One stroke!
There was a buzzing sound, and a layer of indigo blue smooth and smooth barrier rose, instantly covering a radius of 100,000 miles.

Li Xianyang is indeed worthy of the prestigious reputation of the ancient times. The formations he collected are basically the strongest among the same level.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Don't you love me
paragraphs: at this time.
Suddenly, the Indigo Sky Sacred Array unfolded, and Yaochi Yan Fa and others were stunned.
"What happened? How could a formation suddenly appear?"
"Could it be that this formation was arranged by Young Master Su? He said that the sea of sky was not completely refined, just to arrange the formation!!"
"It should be the case, but doesn't it take a long time to set up the formation, isn't it very troublesome? Why did the formation appear all at once?"

"Furthermore, this suddenly appeared formation is extremely powerful at first glance. It is definitely not something that an ordinary formation mage can arrange, at least it is also the most advanced holy rank formation mage."
"I don't understand, this is too exaggerated, but if it is Su Gongzi, it is not impossible to arrange the formation between raising his hands!"
"Well, I think so too. With Young Master Su's immeasurable talent, it's normal for him to be proficient in formations in addition to being a master of weaponry."
"Ah! Young Master Su is really amazing, ah ah ah!"
"Scream? So will I! Young Master Su is awesome, ah!"
When everyone was shocked, they decided not to worry about the details anymore, and just screamed for Young Master Su.
It's hard to hear a person screaming, but if many people scream together, it will appear magnificent, the scene will be vast, the atmosphere will rise, and the scream will be nice.
The concert is like this.
At this time, Su Lang was like a super star that was highly anticipated, and received excited screams from countless fans.
"It's pretty fun.
Su Lang looked at the crowd like a tide below, and couldn't help but smile.
Immediately afterwards, he lifted his pen again, and countless array patterns were born from the tip of the pen, merged into the sea of sky, and formed new arrays again.
These later formations were combined with the Indigo Weiyu Heavenly Sacred Array to form a Super Saint-Step Array.
Moreover, Su Lang continued to portray the formations, until the sky sea's body could no longer accommodate and bear more formations!
By this time, Su Lang had portrayed a total of 9,527 holy rank formations on the sea of sky.
Nearly 10,000 holy rank formations are united, and even if its power has not crossed the sky to reach the immortal level, it is also the top existence among the quasi immortal level!
It can be said that no one can break the defense of the sea of sky as long as they don't encounter a fairy-level opponent!
Moreover, the defensive range of the Sky Sea is extremely terrifying, covering almost the entire Jade Lake Holy City.
"Finally finished."
"This is the strongest holy artifact I have ever refined."
Su Lang showed a happy smile on his face, closed his pen, then stretched out his hand, and the sea of sky shrank like a compass into his palm.
Seeing this scene, everyone immediately understood that the sea of sky was completely refined and couldn't help cheering wildly again.
"The refining of the sea of sky is complete!"
"Master Su has cast the sea of sky with one hand. It's amazing!"
"Master Su, I love you!"
Why don't you love me? You are a man, brother.
Su Lang rolled his eyes helplessly, feeling very speechless at the cheers of people.
At this time.
"Su Lang!"
Chu Xiaobei flew up to Su Lang with curiosity in his eyes, "Is the refining of the sea of sky finished? Show me quickly!"
"Master Su!"
Yaochi Yan Fa and others also surrounded them, and they were so excited that they were almost crying.
"It's just a sacred artifact, not a good thing."
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth and threw the sea of sky to Chu Xiaobei.
The eyes of the five Yaochi Yanfa followed the arc of the sea of sky and fell on Chu Xiaobei's hand.
"Wow, what an exquisite sacred artifact!"

Chu Xiaobei took the sea of sky and couldn't help but praised, "This is definitely the best holy artifact I have ever seen. Even in our Profound Jade Immortal clan, only an immortal artifact can crush it."
Only an immortal artifact can crush a sacred artifact.
So powerful, almost invincible among the saints!
After listening to Chu Xiaobei's evaluation, Yaochi Yan Fa and others' eyes brightened, like a bright searchlight.
"Now, here you are."
When Chu Xiaobei saw Yaochi Yan Fa and the other five being impatient, he smiled and handed them the sea of sky.
