chapters.title: Chapter 594: This person is difficult!
paragraphs: "Yan Fa kowtowed Master Su!"
Yaochi Yan Fa did not directly take the sea of the sky, but knelt down on his knees and bowed solemnly.
"I'll wait to thank Young Master Su, thank Young Master Su for a great kindness!"
The four martial sages including Yaochi Hongxi also knelt on the ground, expressing gratitude.
"Okay, it's just a fair deal."
Su Lang faintly waved his hand, "I will give you the sea of sky, and I will not return the remaining materials."
"Master Su, you refined the Sky Sea, how much of those materials are left?"
"What's more, you even exploded the saint cauldron in order to refine the sea of sky for us. This loss cannot be made up for by those materials at all!"

Yaochi Yan Fa raised his head and handed a space ring with deep gratitude: "Yan Fa is willing to dedicate most of his fortune to Young Master Su. Only in this way can I feel at ease, please don't be too young!"
"I'm waiting too!"
"Master Su, please accept it!"
Yaochi Hongxi and the other four martial sages also took out the space ring and handed it to Su Lang tearfully.
The Yaochi people below saw that their ancestors all knelt to Su Lang, and all knelt down.
The crowd as big as the sea was a bit shorter in an instant!
Seeing this scene, Su Lang's heart burst into laughter!
It did cost a lot of materials to refine the sea of sky, but it was far less than what Yaochi Yan Fa and others had imagined.
It can even be said to be very few.
Su Lang spent about one-fifth of the materials obtained from the Yaochi Saint Clan's secret library.

In addition to the common materials, the precious Valkyrie Soul only used twelve copies, and the remaining seventeen copies, ten of which were used to evolve the Youtian Sword, and seven copies remained.
Those two copies of Wusheng Soul are even more useless, right now they just lie in the storage space!
As for the saint that exploded?
As I said before, after being decomposed, the ‘Aoi Mingyue’ array pen was refined, and there was no loss of even a curl.
It can be said that this wave of Su Lang really made a lot of money.
However, since Yaochi Yan Fa and others have to make up for it, it is not a good idea to refuse, hehe.
"Since your kindness is hard to come by, then I will accept it"
Su Lang smiled faintly, and stretched out his hand to take the ring presented by the Five Sages of Yaochi, "Get up quickly, I am embarrassed."
"Thank you so much Su Gongzi!"
Yaochi Yan Fa said gratefully, "The sea of sky will be the foundation for the Yaochi people to settle down, and it will be the opportunity for our race to grow and develop and impact the immortals!"
"It's not that simple to attack the fairy clan."
Chu Xiaobei smiled and handed the sea of sky to Yaochi Yan Fa, "However, it is always good to have ambition."
"Thank you Miss Chu for your encouragement!"
Yaochi Yan Fa nodded excitedly, and immediately painted his hand, reaching out to pick up the sea of sky.
This is the moment when the Sea of Sky is officially delivered.
The eyes of countless people are falling on the sea of sky.
And at this moment.
"Hahahaha!
A burst of laughter came, and the voice was unbridled, piercing the world!
"who is it!?"
Countless people's complexion changed drastically, and they looked at the place where the sound came from.
Su Lang and Chu Xiaobei, as well as Yaochi Yan Fa and other five sages also changed their expressions suddenly, following their reputation.
I saw where the world meets, one person walks in backlight, carrying endless power, and the void trembles wherever he passes, and the light is distorted!
"Unexpectedly, when investigating the demise of a small branch, I would get such a big gain!"
"Quasi-xian weapon, a rare weapon in ordinary martial arts, hahahaha, my luck is really great!"
The figure was frantic, and gradually approached, revealing its true face.
This person has eagle-like eyes and a wild expression on his face. He is dressed in a reddish black shirt.
A long way away, Su Lang could smell the terrifying smell of blood on his body.
The reason why the shirt turned red in black was because it was stained with endless blood!
"He is from Tutianlou!"
"And his cultivation base, Quasi Wonderland!!"
Yaochi Yan Fa's eyes were violent, revealing a deep panic.
Yaochi Hongxi and the others are like falling into an ice cave, chilling all over!
"This person... is difficult!"
Su Lang narrowed his eyes and called up the attribute panel of the madman in black.

The dignified quasi-immortal expert, unexpectedly named Cai Liao, and he would become a rookie if he was not careful.

"Princess Su Lang is so relaxed and happy, it seems that there must be a way to deal with this quasi-immortal from Tutianlou!"
"Haha, you deserve to be Young Master Su Lang. He is powerful and has a solid background, so he doesn't even care about the immortals."

at this time.

Otherwise, I will let you live worse than death, and slaughter all the people of the Yaochi tribe, and let your entire tribe disappear from the top of the Canglan Continent! "
As he said, Cai Liao's eyes stared at the sky and sea in Chu Xiaobei's hand intently, revealing a thick color of greed.
In his opinion, the strongest of these people in front of him is the Seven-Star Martial Saint level woman.

As for the rest of the people, they are even chickens, vulnerable, and don't need to be put in the eye.
"Ha ha!"
"A quasi-immortal in a mere mere dare to be arrogant in front of our Young Master Su Lang!
Yaochi Yan Fa sneered again and again, "Do you know the identity of our Young Master Su Lang? Speaking out will scare you to death!"
"what!?"
After hearing what Yao Chi Yan Fa said, Cai Liao suddenly looked at him.
His face was surprised, and his eyes fell on the handsome young man.
For this young man, he is very concerned.
Because just now he witnessed the whole process of this young man refining the quasi-immortal artifact from a distance.
For such a talented person, Cai Liao would of course be reluctant to kill, so he only said before that Su Lang and others would kneel down as slaves.

"Could it be that the identity of that young man turned out to be a direct descendant of the imperial clan?"
"Only the noble existence of the emperor can you dare not put the immortal in your eyes!"
"However, if that person is really a descendant of the emperor, how can he come to this remote place where the birds don't shit, and mix with a little saint?"
Thinking of this, Cai Liao couldn't help but wonder.
At this time.
Chu Xiaobei glanced at Su Lang and bit her silver teeth.
She stepped forward and said condescendingly to Cai Liao: "Where did the dog from here dare to bark at my son?
Now if you knelt on your knees and kowtow to apologize, my son might still spare your life! "
After speaking, Chu Xiaobei retreated behind Su Lang, making a maid looking like Su Lang's head.

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Actually use it to roll
paragraphs: "Master Su, I love you!"
"Master Su, Master Su, you are the sun and moon in the sky, and I will look up to you every day from now on!"
"Long live Su Gongzi, and long live Su Gongzi!"
"Nima, do you dare to curse Young Master Su for a short life? Come here, beat him!"
"I was wrong, I was wrong, I'm quick! Su Gongzi is immortal and immortal!"
Countless people's gazes of worship and admiration gathered on Su Lang, and the cheers in their mouths exploded in Cai Liao's ears like thunder.
At this time, Cai Liao really wanted to cry without tears.
The previous organization said that a subordinate force in a remote place was destroyed, and the man who started it was a great sage, and then he was sent.
When he first came, before he had time to contact his subordinates, he saw that Su Lang was refining the sea of sky, secretly saying that he was falling into the sky.
However, he never imagined, where is the falling pie? It is a huge iron plate!
Thinking of this, Cai Liao couldn't help but hate those subordinates.
Those guys who engage in intelligence are too Temad!
He didn't even figure out his identity, so he was sent to kill! ?
Or is it just a trap? Someone in the organization is dealing with him! ?
Think about it carefully, it's really possible!
Cai Liao was horrified: "Made, fortunately I am lucky, and they didn't plan to kill me...otherwise my little life..."
"Hey, it's time to kowtow."
"You have one second left."
Su Lang's contemptuous voice suddenly sounded.
"what!?"
"Yes, yes! I'll just kowtow!"
Cai Liao came back to his senses and immediately banged his head three times under Su Lang's feet.
Obviously he was in the air, and I don't know how he knocked out such a loud noise, maybe he has special knocking skills! ?
"Cai Liao, forget about it today."
Su Lang hung his eyelids and looked down at Cai Liao condescendingly, "If I dare to appear in my sight, I'm not welcome."
"Yes Yes Yes!"
"I will get out of here, I will get out now!"
Cai Liao nodded frantically, then curled up, actually rolling.
Immediately after.
Cai Liao rolled away in the gaze and ridicule of Su Lang and others, as well as the unknown number of Yaochi people below.
When I came here, I was overwhelmed and unstoppable. When I left, I shrank my head and pinched my tail and off. It was really uncontrollable.
"The patriarch of Yaochi."
"You quickly activate the sea of sky."
Su Lang turned to look at Yaochi Yan Fa, "After all, I can protect you for a while, but I can't protect you for the rest of your life. You still have to rely on yourself for the saints of Yaochi."
"Yes!"
"Thank you Master Su for saving our Yaochi clan!"
Yaochi Yan Fa bowed deeply, then knelt on both knees, three more rattles.
Yaochi Hongxi and other martial sages, as well as the number of billions of Yaochi people below, also knelt down.
"Master Xie Su save our Yaochi clan!"
"Master Xie Su, save our Yaochi clan!!!"
"Master Xie Su..."
There was a cry of harmony, and the sound was earth-shattering.
"All are up."
Su Lang smiled faintly and helped Yaochi Yan Fa, "You quickly activate the sea of sky, I am fine now, just to guide you how to manipulate."
"Thank you so much Su Gongzi!"
Yaochi Yan Pharaoh was in tears and trembling all over.
However, at any rate, he was also the lord of the clan, he quickly cleared his emotions and took over the sea of sky from Chu Xiaobei's expression.
Holding the sea of quasi-immortality, Yaochi Yan Fa felt that he was holding the future and hope of the Yaochi clan.
Immediately after.
Yaochi Yan Fa poured spiritual power into the sea of sky, and immediately understood most of its usage.
The sea of sky is a comprehensive treasure that gathers various functions such as flying, defense, counterattack, spiritual gathering and living.
Its flight speed and counter-offensive ability reach Jiuxing Wusheng, and its defense ability is invincible below the immortal level.
Its spiritual gathering ability is also extremely abnormal, once activated, the concentration of spiritual energy will be stronger than the heart of the mountains!
Moreover, buildings can be built on the sky and sea without affecting its own functions.
It can be said that the sea of sky is a perfect headquarters. It is impeccable to fight, run, run, and act.

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Boiling Yaochi Holy City
paragraphs: "Master Su!"
Yaochi Yan Fa asked, "I don't know how much energy the sky sea needs and how many people control it?"
"There are twenty-four energy points in the sea of sky, and spirit jade is used as energy."
"Except for this, only 24 Valkyries are required to preside over the Twelve Sacred Artifacts and Twelve Bridges."
"Subordinates can be assisted by Wu Zun, the number is arbitrary, of course, the more the number, the better."
"In a special period, the Martial Saint general can be replaced by the Martial God. The more Martial Saints who control the Sky Sea, the stronger the Sky Sea."

"If the Twelve Sacred Artifacts and Twelve Bridges are all controlled by Martial Saints, and the rest of the controllers are all replaced by Martial Gods, then the sea of sky's top strength will be exerted!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, revealing a faint smile.
Yaochi Yan Fa nodded excitedly and asked, "Master Su, does the formation on the sky sea need a professional formation mage to control it?"
"No need!"
"As long as the energy is sufficient, the above formation will operate automatically, without human manipulation."
Su Lang smiled and said, "Moreover, all formations can be restored automatically, without the need for array mage repair."
"Then it's too much trouble!"
Yaochi Yan Fa was extremely surprised, "I originally thought that many formation mages were needed to control the formation together."
"Haha."
Su Lang nodded, "You send someone to activate the sea of sky now."
"Yes!"
Yaochi Yan Fa showed excitement and turned to look at Yaochi Hongxi, "You have heard what Master Su said, go find someone!"
"Okay, let's go right away."
Yaochi Hongxi and others dispersed immediately and ran to find someone.
Not long.
All the Valkyrie appeared in front of Su Lang, their expressions excited and respectful.
Immediately afterwards, more Wu Zun was selected as a member of the sea of sky.
"let's start."
Su Lang waved his hand and said, "I will not interfere with you, I will rely on you."
"Yes!"
Yaochi Yan Fa solemnly nodded his head and was about to activate the sea of sky.
But at this moment, he suddenly paused.
"what happened?"
Su Lang frowned.
Yaochi Yan Fa said: "Master Su, I plan to go to the holy city of Yaochi to activate the sea of sky!"
"That's fine, let's go."
Su Lang nodded. He knew that Yaochi Yan Fa's thoughts were nothing more than to give power to the various races in the holy city of Yaochi.
Especially the Chiri Saint Clan and Tianyun Saint Clan, these two races must be in the Yaochi Holy City.
Yao Chi Yan Fa wants to let the two races truly feel the terrifying power of the sea of sky!
Soon.
Yaochi Yan Fa ordered everyone to go to the holy city of Yaochi.
Suddenly, countless people marched forward in cheers, and the crowd flocked to the holy city of Yaochi like a tide.
The location of the refining sky sea is between the heart of the mountains and the holy city of Yaochi, not far away.
And there is also a teleportation array available.
Soon, Su Lang and others arrived at the holy city of Yaochi.
Those Yaochi people with low cultivation bases also arrived one after another.
At this moment.
Su Lang and Chu Xiaobei hovered above the clouds above the holy city of Yaochi, while Yan Fa and others surrounded the Yaochi holy city, slightly behind, showing respect.
And those countless Yaochi people poured into the holy city, causing a great sensation.
"Oh my God! Why are there so many people!?"
"It's all Yaochi people. They were summoned and left before, but now they are all back."
"I don't know what happened, did Wuyang Demon Cave's counterattack come?"
"No, what are they talking about the sea of sky, what Young Master Su, invincible below the immortal level, what are you kidding about!?"
"Aren't they crazy? Invincible below the immortal level, it's ridiculous!"
"Fuck, someone here dare to criticize Young Master Su, come here and beat him!"
"Beat me to death!"
"Just cut the limbs!?"
The entire Jade Lake holy city was boiling, and everyone knew about Lord Su and the sea of sky.
Those who dared to contempt and question were all taken care of.
The people of the Chiri Saint Clan and the Tianyun Saint Clan were shocked, and all the undercover forces came out to inquire for more detailed information.
But they didn’t spend much effort at all, they knew all the information
——Su Lang used his own power to refine the quasi-immortal tool Sky Sea for the Yaochi saints, and forced the quasi-immortal of Tuan Tianlou to kneel and kowtow!

A wave of ripples appeared in the sky, dispelling all the white clouds, exposing Su Lang and others above the clouds.
Seeing Su Lang, the enthusiastic fans of the Yaochi tribe went crazy instantly.
They yelled ‘Master Su’, and flew towards the sky one after another, trying to get closer to Su Lang until they were cut off by the defense formation.
Those who couldn't fly climbed to the top of the tall buildings and waved their hands in excitement.
At this moment, I don't know how many millions of people worshipped Su Lang's eyes!
Everyone remembered Su Lang's extremely handsome figure.
at the same time.
Su Lang looked at the boiling holy city below and couldn't help but smile.
Soon.
Su Lang held his hands behind his back, and said to Yaochi Yan Fa with a calm expression: "Let's get started."
"it is good!"
Yaochi Yan Fa nodded, then directly activated the sea of sky.
In an instant, the sea of sky burst out with a strong light, like a new sun appeared in everyone's eyes.
Its light is so bright, so dazzling!
At this time.
"Boom!
A whole roar suddenly sounded!
That is the sea of sky is expanding at an extremely terrifying speed, its speed surpasses the speed of sound, causing a continuous sonic boom.
In addition, the sonic boom also brought spectacular sonic boom clouds, and the entire sky instantly covered countless clouds and mists.
The sea of sky is still swelling, and the shadow it casts is like the mouth of a giant beast, swallowing the entire Jade Lake holy city!
The terrifying coercion drooped down, and the original protective array of the holy city of Yaochi was continuously distorted.
"The sky has changed!!"
"The defensive formation is twisting!!"
"It's too powerful, too scary!"
Countless people were stunned. Is this the mighty power of the Sky Sea?
At this moment, Yao Chi Yan Fa let out a loud shout: "Everyone obeys orders, enter the sea of sky and take control in the following order!"
Under the arrangement of Yaochi Yanfa, Yaochi Hongxi and other martial sages, as well as the selected martial Wuzun, entered the designated location in the sea of sky.
Su Lang found that Yaochi Yiran was among them, so she went to control a part of the artifact.
Yaochi Yan Fa also went in and mastered a holy part.
Immediately after.
The people in charge of the twelve sacred parts and twelve bridges took out a lot of spirit jade and put it into the energy point.
In an instant.
The sea of sky bloomed again and became bigger and bigger.
A layer of gleaming indigo blue spherical barrier emerged from the center of the sky and sea, and began to extend to the sky, the ground and the distance.
This moist and silky hood stretches very fast, covering the entire Jade Lake Holy City within a few breaths, and it continues to extend outward.
It wasn't until the area covered by the hood reached three times that of the holy city of Yaochi before it gradually stopped.
At this moment, the sky and the underground of the entire Jade Lake Holy City were protected by the defensive barrier of the Sky Sea.
In addition, the remaining formations on the sea of sky also began to play a role.
The space imprisonment array method makes all the teleportation arrays in the city unusable, and the space-type techniques cannot be used.
The Spirit Gathering Array was activated, and Fangyuan didn't know how many tens of thousands of miles of spiritual energy was sucked into the inside of the hood like torn.
The concentration of aura inside the Sky City increased a lot at once.
This is only a moment of activation. With the passage of time, the concentration of aura will reach a level that is stronger than the heart of the mountains!
But just so, it has already made the warriors in the holy city crazy.
As the concentration of aura increases, their cultivation speed can also increase, which means that they make faster progress, have more opportunities to impact higher realms, and have more lifespan!
As a result, everyone began to cheer again, and the image of Young Master Su Lang became extremely sacred in their hearts.
at the same time.
In a remote valley, the mist is steaming, and the mountain pine meets the deer, which is a fairy family scene.

A long stream of light flew in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Reincarnation fairy illusion
paragraphs: The streamer stopped over the valley and turned into a man in a black and red shirt.
This person is Cai Liao who rolled away from Su Lang with his tail tucked away.
At this moment, his eyes were blood red, his blue veins were violently jumping, and his Qiqiao was smoking, obviously he was extremely angry.
"Dogs, it's all you guys who don't do a good job of intelligence, which caused me to suffer such a big loss. Not only was my dignity and face lost, but I almost lost my life!"
"I can't swallow this breath, you have to pay the price for your inaction! Ah -! Samsara fairy pupil!"
Cai Liao roared, and the pupils in his eyes instantly dispersed and turned into whirlpools.
The sky behind him also suddenly tore two tightly closed gaps!
next moment.
The tightly closed narrow gap suddenly opened, forming horrible eyes that were thousands of feet long!
With the appearance of these giant eyes, the range of hundreds of thousands of miles suddenly became hazy, as if entering another weird world.
This is the reincarnation fairy pupil manifested by Cai Liao with supernatural powers.
Cooperating with the Martial Saint Realm, a reincarnation fantasy space can be formed, and the creatures included in it can be killed!
At this moment.
The information warriors of the Slaughter Tower hidden in the valley found the strangeness and couldn't help being shocked.
"What the is going on, how did the surrounding environment suddenly change."
"I have seen that this is a scene caused by the reincarnation fairy pupil, and people from the Qiantong tribe do it to us!"
"What? How come people from the Thousand Eyes clan appear here, and will they do it to us? Could it be that Cai Liao, who was sent from the headquarters, did it?"
"Damn it, it's definitely him, what the is he going crazy, he actually uses reincarnation fairy pupils on us!
"The headquarters sent him here to clean up the great saint, why did he shoot us instead!?"
"Contact the headquarters quickly, quickly!"
All the warriors in the valley gathered together, and their eyes were full of fear and surprise.
The leading warrior is a one-star martial sage, he immediately took out the jade card of communication, and wanted to send a message to the headquarters of the slaying tower.
But at this moment.
They suddenly discovered that the surrounding environment had changed instantly.
The hazy and illusory scene turned into an entity in an instant. Upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a torture room!
In this torture room, there are countless various cruel instruments of torture floating around!
The ground was covered with a thick layer of coagulated black blood, and there were stumps and broken arms everywhere.
If you look closely, you can find that the torture instruments are like living creatures, twisting their bodies from time to time, even growing faces and opening their blood basins.

In the entire fairy pupil fantasy realm of Samsara, just the murderous aura and evil aura, made the Tuantianlou intelligence personnel stand upside down, their hair is terrified, and the whole person is in terror, almost unable to move.
At this moment, the torture instruments that were like living creatures all flew up and fell on everyone!
"Cai Liao did it!!"
"The jade card of communication has expired, and the message cannot be sent!"
"Damn it, why did Cai Liao rebel, and why did he act on our little remote intelligence team.
"Quick, let him stop! Begging for mercy, begging for mercy!"
"Ah, it hurts, it hurts! Lord Cai, please let me go!"
"Master Cai, where did we offend you, ah, it hurts!"
"No, no, don't cut my foot, ah--!"
All the personnel of the Tutianlou intelligence team were surrounded by various instruments of torture, and countless tortures were performed one after another, which was simply horrible.
Even the one-star martial sage did not have the slightest strength to fight back, and he was still slaughtered and desperate to survive!
At high altitude.
Cai Liao looked down at the crowd, his eyes were as cold as ice, and his face was grim and cruel.
Immediately afterwards, his voice that sounded like the nine Nethers swept across the entire Samsara fairy pupil illusion.
"A bunch of miscellaneous things have lost my dignity and almost lost my life!"
"The Great Sage who destroyed the Wuyang Demon Cavern is clearly a maid of the direct blood of the emperor!"
"Hehe, it's okay for you, you can't find such important information, or you know it but deliberately didn't tell me, let me go up and die!?"
"Hmph, I know someone in the organization is dissatisfied with me, you must be instructed by them!"
"Dare to do something with me, I will kill you first today, and then go back and ask the host to find out the infighters, and hold justice for me!"
